About this estimate

The model averages the prices of 3 similar training examples. Similarity includes suburb, type, rooms, parking and sale month.

It was trained on 95 properties and tested on 24. Its average absolute test error was about $1.20 million, with a few very large errors.

Study prototype only. It can miss views, condition, strata costs and unusual luxury features. This is not a professional valuation.

Data: 119 disclosed sales in Parramatta, Blacktown and Mosman. Sources: Domain and realestate.com.au. This small sample does not represent the whole Sydney market.
